name: Shipybara

sources.title: Shipybara pricing — Free, Premium $50, SEO Package $69, directory submission service

conditions: Free plan is capped at 18 slots per week with launches batched every Monday at midnight UTC
Free plan only yields a dofollow backlink if the project finishes top 3 or the Shipybara badge is displayed; otherwise the link is not guaranteed dofollow
Free scheduling horizon up to 180 days vs 30 days on Premium
Account sign-in (Google or GitHub) required to submit
requirements: A launched or launchable product with a public URL
Account via Google or GitHub OAuth
preparation: Preferred launch Monday (all launches happen Mondays at midnight UTC)
Shipybara badge embed plan if relying on the free tier for a dofollow link
workflow: Fill the project form and choose Free ($0) or Premium ($50)
Schedule into an available Monday launch slot
Product goes live on the homepage in the weekly batch
watchFor: Aggressive upsells: $69 SEO article package and a $99-$249 directory-submission service run by LaunchDirectories.com
Free-tier dofollow is conditional — read 'Dofollow backlink (Top 3 or badge)' literally
countsAsLive: Project appears in the Monday homepage batch and on /trending with its own project page
unknowns: Exact badge requirements for the free-tier dofollow link
Whether free submissions can be rejected outright or only queued
